headline: Two axes, one honest verdict: coastal is the route right now
body:
Read the trend plainly: 15.8, 10.1, 16.1, zero, then a 65.6-mile spike, and 17.5 so far this week. That's one strong week inside six erratic ones, not a build. On distance, your longest single ride is 17.9 miles — you'd need roughly three and a half times that on event day, so 62 miles isn't supported yet by either route. On climbing, the gap is wider. Your biggest day is 736 feet; Gibraltar alone is 2,551 in 6.1 miles, and the climb version asks 6,600 total. Your 3.6-mile Gibraltar effort was a start, not the climb.

With 45 days left, the coastal route is the honest call. To change that, you'd need consecutive weeks of steady volume plus a full Gibraltar ascent done after 30 miles.

This week: Friday's 8 mph and 76 degrees suits a climbing day; Saturday suits your longest ride yet. Wednesday and Thursday gust into the low 20s — spin short. Sunday through Tuesday carry 25–38 percent rain, so stay flexible.
